shared_elements: standing human figure in a vertical rectangular panel
figure holding or grasping an object
raised-relief carving of clothed figure with patterned garment
panel with figure(s) filling most of the field
justification: Both show human figures in low relief filling a tall rectangular field, with headgear, patterned garments and hands holding/raising objects, which is a broadly comparable scheme. But A depicts two bearded figures strictly in profile with rigid linear beards, curls and fringed robes arranged in registers, while B shows a frontal, densely packed figure with sprawling plumed headdress and surrounding ornament and glyph-like blocks, so the specific forms and conventions differ sharply.
